baby.viewerNotice: You have view-only access to this baby, so logging is turned off.
baby.birthFuture: Birth date cannot be in the future.
baby.createPrompt: Create a baby to start logging, or open an invite link someone shared with you.

roleHints.Owner: Full control, including members and invites
roleHints.Parent: Can log and edit everything, and manage medications and settings
roleHints.Caregiver: Can log events and edit their own entries
roleHints.Doctor: A healthcare professional: sees the sections you share, writes notes and measurements

baby.caregiverNamed: You are a caregiver for {{name}}: you can log events and edit your own entries. The parents manage everything else.
baby.nameHelp: Leave empty to use the label below. A real name stays on your account and is seen by everyone you share the baby with.
baby.labelHelp: Shown when there is no name. Typing a custom text or a name is your choice.
baby.birthWeekNotice: Lotties converts the date to the week of birth (the Monday of that week) and stores only the week. The exact day is not kept.
baby.birthWeekStored: Only the week of birth is stored (week starting {{date}}).
baby.birthExactStored: The exact birth date is stored.
baby.storeOnlyWeekDone: Now only the week of birth is stored.
baby.weekBasis: Based on the week of birth, so ages can be up to 6 days off.
